author: dilpickel
body:
Hello dilpickel here and I bring you my fifth map!
(Thanks to Vobaseball12 for suggesting a TM map).

Snakes!

Map Name: Snakes!
Map Gamemode: Nebula DTM. (Tournament map)
Map Creator: dilpickel.

Intro:
In this map players will fight for ground on the backs of snakes! Be sure to get the diamonds in the middle before the other team does for an advantage.


Info: (per side).
8 platforms.
4 diamond.
2 snakes!
2 monuments.

ADDED: More space! bigger platforms to PvP.
REMOVED:

Here's some pictures:
http://imgur.com/a/WD4VA (more pics).
